code.text: COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows severe hypoxemia and acidemia (O2 saturation, pO2, and pH markedly low), leukopenia, neutropenia, lymphopenia, thrombocytopenia, elevated inflammatory markers (CRP, ferritin, LDH), and impaired renal function (creatinine high). These findings suggest acute severe systemic illness, possibly sepsis with multi-organ involvement and respiratory failure. Immediate clinical evaluation and intervention are strongly recommended.
